svg.title: PyG training pipeline roadmap with documentation links
svg.desc: A vertical roadmap of seven numbered stages connected by a spine: Data, DataLoader, Split and sampling, Model selection, Training, Evaluation, and Inference. The first four stages are green, marking graph-specific concepts, and link to PyG documentation. The last three are gray, marking stages identical to standard PyTorch, with no links.

g.text: One big graph, or many small graphs
Merges many graphs into one batch
Standard PyTorch loop, same as always
